recommendation: Keep the audit. Do not restore @all unless a new Vocab work-group decision defines an interoperable replacement for global terminology search.
issue_request: FHIR-5794 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked FHIR core to define one magic URI for all known value sets for terminology operations such as cross-value-set text filtering and code validation.
initial_application: SVN revision 5690, represented in git as c4bfe496c8, added an Operations across all value sets section to source/terminology-service.html defining http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/@all. FHIR-8447 later clarified that its interpretation, including version coverage, was server-specific.
additional_context: FHIR-19442 is a later Published Vocab decision for the same @all section. It resolved to remove the section because the feature was very limited, server-specific, and did not support interoperability. The R5 vocab batch commit 9500b398d1 removed the narrative section, and existing combined-branch commit 0f21a3cc2cac772f1d47c2ad96baa56e7a530978 removed the stale publish.ini redirect.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/terminology-service.html and publish.ini contain no @all section or redirect, which is correct after the later FHIR-19442 decision superseded FHIR-5794's original request.
